title: A tidier footer
body: The links at the foot of every page are now grouped under Explore, Help, Your privacy and Legal.

title: Search by author
body: Search can now find books by who wrote them: choose Author above the search box and type any part of a name, such as tolkien or le guin. Title search works as before.

title: Goals and streaks in the bell
body: The bell now tells you when a streak of three days or more ends tonight (from 6 pm, until you read), when you're one or two books from this year's goal, and when you reach it.

title: Pay yearly, two months free
body: Every plan can now be paid yearly, at ten times the monthly price. Choose Yearly on Plans, or switch from monthly at any time: your year starts straight away, with the unused part of the month taken off. The bell reminds you 30 days before your year renews.

title: Move up a plan in one tap
body: When this month's listening or your offline devices run out, the message offers the next plan up and opens its checkout straight away.

title: A heads-up before your listening runs out
body: On Basic and Standard, the player shows how much of this month's listening is left, and the bell lets you know once the household has used most of it.

title: The New label in notifications
body: The New label on a notification now sits next to its title instead of stretching across the panel.

title: Plan limits on listening and offline devices
body: Each plan's audiobook hours and offline devices now apply: Basic 5 hours a month and 1 device, Standard 30 hours and 3 devices, Premium unlimited listening and 5 devices. Account → Plan and billing shows this month's listening and lets you free a device.

title: Favourite genres from the full list
body: Pick favourites from all nineteen genres when you set up or edit a profile. Up to two that aren't already on Home get a row of their own there, and more of our own titles are tagged Thriller, Historical Fiction and Fantasy.

title: More genres to browse and search
body: Alongside Technology, Adventure, Sci-Fi, Fiction, Non-Fiction and Horror, you can now browse and search Fantasy, Mystery, Thriller, Romance, Classics, Historical Fiction, Young Adult, Children's, Biography & Memoir, History, Science, Self-Help and Poetry.

title: What's new
body: This page: every new feature, fix and update, newest first. Turn on the monthly round-up of the biggest changes in Account → Preferences.

title: Who's who
body: In the reader of a public-domain classic, the people icon lists the characters you've met so far, with what the book has shown about them. Nobody you haven't met yet is listed, and nothing later is given away.

title: Import from Goodreads or StoryGraph
body: Bring your reading history: export it from either site and choose Import in My Library. We find each book, show you the matches, and add them with your shelves and star ratings. Books you'd already read don't count towards this year's goal.

title: Household reading challenges
body: Take on a goal together, like 5 books in November or 20 hours this month. Everyone in the household can join and see each other's progress in My Library → Goals.

title: Share your year
body: Year in Review can now be shared as a picture: your books, hours, longest streak, covers and favourite genre, in a dark or light card.

title: New books from authors you follow
body: When an author you follow has a new book out, it shows in the bell, and a weekly email lists them. Turn the email off in Account → Preferences.

title: The notification bell
body: The bell at the top counts what's new for your profile: books you set Remind me on that are out, new posts in your book clubs and new books from authors you follow. What you've seen is seen on every device.

title: Cancel at least 48 hours before your billing date
body: To stop the next charge, cancel at least 48 hours before your billing date. Cancelling later still ends your membership, after one more month. Account shows which applies before you confirm. No refunds.

title: The price after a promo code
body: Account now shows what your plan will cost once a promo code stops applying.

title: Clearer plans and more answers
body: Each plan lists everything it includes, and Common questions now covers billing, pausing, gifts, audiobooks, importing, privacy and the AI features.

title: A confirmation when you delete your account
body: After an account is deleted, we email the address to confirm what was removed and that nothing more will be charged.

title: No sideways scrolling on narrow phones
body: The header on the home page no longer pushes Sign up off the screen while the app's font is loading.

title: Invite friends to your book club by email
body: Send an invitation from the club's page; the email links straight to joining.

title: An email when a book you're waiting for comes out
body: Set Remind me on a book that isn't out yet, and we'll email you on the day as well as showing it on Home.

title: Gift memberships
body: Give one, three, six or twelve months of any plan, paid once. The code never expires.
